create_bot.description: Send a bot to a Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex or GoTo meeting to record and transcribe it, now or at a time you choose. Use 'Get bot' later for the recording and transcript.
create_bot.name: create_bot

parameters.description: The link to the Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex or GoTo meeting, including its password if it has one.
parameters.name: meeting_url

parameters.description: The name people in the meeting see. Defaults to Meeting Notetaker.
parameters.name: bot_name

parameters.description: When the bot should join. Leave empty to send it in now. A bot scheduled more than 10 minutes ahead can still be changed or deleted.
parameters.name: join_at

parameters.description: How to transcribe the meeting. Recall.ai's own is billed by Recall.ai.
parameters.name: transcription

parameters.description: The language spoken in the meeting. Defaults to detecting it.
parameters.name: transcription_language

parameters.description: What the recording shows. Defaults to video of the speaker.
parameters.name: recording_layout

parameters.description: A message the bot posts in the meeting chat when it joins, such as a note that the meeting is being recorded.
parameters.name: join_message

parameters.description: Have Recall.ai delete the recording after this long. Empty keeps it.
parameters.name: delete_recording_after_hours

parameters.description: Notes to keep on the bot, such as a deal or ticket number, as names and values, for example {"deal": "D-1042"}. Find bots by them with 'List bots'.
parameters.name: metadata

audio_url.description: The link to download the audio, once ready

bot_name.description: The name the bot has in the meeting

join_at.description: When the bot joins or joined, as ISO 8601

meeting_id.description: The meeting's id on that app

meeting_url.description: The meeting: its platform, meeting_id and password if any

metadata.description: The notes you added when sending the bot

platform.description: The meeting app: zoom, google_meet, microsoft_teams, webex...

recording_config.description: How the bot was set to record

recordings.description: The bot's recordings, each with its status and media_shortcuts

status.description: Where the bot is: scheduled, joining_call, in_waiting_room, in_call_not_recording, in_call_recording, call_ended, done, fatal or media_expired

status_changes.description: Every status the bot has been through, with code, sub_code, message and created_at

status_message.description: A sentence about the status, when Recall gives one

status_sub_code.description: More about the status, such as meeting_not_found

transcript_url.description: The link to download the transcript, once ready

video_url.description: The link to download the video, once ready

delete_scheduled_bot.description: Cancel a bot that has not joined its meeting yet by deleting it. Bots that have started can't be deleted.
delete_scheduled_bot.name: delete_scheduled_bot

parameters.description: The bot. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: bot_id

get_usage.description: Get how much bot time the workspace used in a period, in seconds and hours, to watch what Recall.ai will bill.
get_usage.name: get_usage

parameters.description: The first day to count, in UTC. Defaults to 30 days ago.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: The last day to count, in UTC. Defaults to today.

bot_total_hours.description: The same in hours, to two places

list_bots.name: list_bots

parameters.description: Only bots in one of these states. Leave empty for all.

parameters.description: Only bots sent to this meeting link.
parameters.name: meeting_url

parameters.description: To find bots by a note you added with 'Send bot to meeting', the note's name. Give its value below too.

parameters.description: The value the note must have.
parameters.name: metadata_value

parameters.description: Which page to get, from 1. Use 'next_page' from an earlier run.

description: Send meeting bots to Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex and GoTo meetings, schedule and manage them, read their recordings and transcripts, and start workflows when a recording is ready.

recall_ai_bot_done_trigger.description: Runs when a bot has left its meeting and its recording and transcript are ready, with the links to download them. Bots already finished when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.audio_url: The link to download the audio, once ready
output.bot_name: The name the bot had in the meeting
output.join_at: When the bot joined or was due to join
output.meeting_id: The meeting's id on that app
output.metadata: The notes you added when sending it
output.platform: The meeting app, such as zoom or google_meet
output.recordings: Its recordings, with their media links
output.status_message: A sentence saying what happened, when it failed
output.status_sub_code: More about why it failed, such as meeting_not_found
output.transcript_url: The link to download the transcript, once ready
output.video_url: The link to download the video, once ready

recall_ai_bot_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a bot could not join or record its meeting, such as a link that leads to no meeting, with what went wrong. Bots that failed before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.audio_url: The link to download the audio, once ready
output.bot_name: The name the bot had in the meeting
output.join_at: When the bot joined or was due to join
output.meeting_id: The meeting's id on that app
output.metadata: The notes you added when sending it
output.platform: The meeting app, such as zoom or google_meet
output.recordings: Its recordings, with their media links
output.status_message: A sentence saying what happened, when it failed
output.status_sub_code: More about why it failed, such as meeting_not_found
output.transcript_url: The link to download the transcript, once ready
output.video_url: The link to download the video, once ready
